sections.title: Header bar
sections.what: Draws the header with the brand, one link per tool, the theme switch and a sign in or sign out control.
sections.why: One reusable bar that shows the current page and the sign-in state.
sections.watch_out: Whether the sign-in control appears depends entirely on the authentication setting.

summary: The top navigation bar for landing pages, with the brand, a link to each tool, a theme switch and a sign in or sign out button.
purpose: Gives visitors one consistent way to move between tools and to sign in or out.
why: Likely reason: a shared header for the landing pages; the neutral brand option hides the logo so other branding can be used.
how: Shows a brand link to the tools page, then one link per tool from the content list, with the current page marked. On the right it shows the theme switch and, unless authentication is disabled, either a sign out button when signed in or a sign in button that goes to the login page.
inputs: A section label, an optional flag to hide the logo, the sign-in state from the auth hook, and the tool list from content.
outputs: A rendered header bar. Sign out calls the logout function, and sign in navigates to the login page.
risks: When authentication is disabled through `AUTH_DISABLED`, no sign-in or sign-out control appears. That is intended for local or demo use and must not reach a real deployment.
debug: If the sign-in button is missing, check the `AUTH_DISABLED` value. If a tool link is missing or not highlighted, check the tool list in content and the current address.
